responsibility: Implements the PA-RISC target hook layer for the D front end. It supplies HPPA-specific builtin version identifiers (`HPPA` versus `HPPA64`, plus hard/soft-float tags) and registers `__traits(getTargetInfo, ...)` handlers that report PA float ABI and SOM object-format information from target flags, bridging the generic D target interface to PA backend configuration rather than affecting code generation itself.
